eps.d: MI-5 Agent John Drake is in Rome investigating the murder of a banker who's embezzled a large amount of gold from his employers.The trail leads through a seemingly uninterested wife and a lady friend of the banker who may not want to be found.
Drake flies to Paris to find an international killer.His tries to retrieve not kill him, but that becomes more complicated with the involvement of a young woman.
Josetta is a young blind woman who is the only one who can identify her brother's killer.Drake tries to help her
Drake travels to the Arabian Desert to investigate stories of slavery.While there he befriends a Muslim boy and helps a stranded showgirl who believes Drake is a slave broker
At the request of an old enemy, Drake takes charge of security as the President of Boravia and his wife visit London.
When a dazed girl is found wandering along a country lane, dressed only in her pajamas, Drake discovers a plot to assassinate a Balkan President.

When Drake is shown a photograph of a young girl who is the victim of drugs, he sets out for the Middle East to break up the ring supplying opium. He is aided by an American agent, Sandi Lewis. Together they trace the source of the drugs, with the help of a courageous little man.
When the daughter of a wealthy industrialist is kidnapped, Drake impersonates her crippled father in an attempt to save her without having to hand over crucial designs.
John Drake has to impersonate a prisoner who has just been released after serving a sentence for bombings. His assignment is to infiltrate a group of IRA commandos.
Drake flies to a small Caribbean State to investigate the apparent suicide of an American economics expert, he uncovers a plot to obtain large sums of money, and in return he nearly loses his life.
When someone is leaking information from the American Embassy in Vienna, Drake is called in to investigate when the finger of guilt points to the Ambassador.
When a young, beautiful refugee pleads for political asylum, Drake is called in to investigate by his superior, Hardy. When the girl's sister arrives, Drake has a double problem to solve.

Drake's assignment is to find a double for James Carpenter, an American who is confined to the US Embassy in a Caribbean city. Finding the double is only half of the problem. Substituting him under the eyes of the police is the other.

Drake travels to Kashmir in Northern India to seek out Noel Goddard, a former executive in the Indian Government, now a traitor. On identifying Drake, Goddard is given the message: 'John Drake. NATO agent. Eliminate.'
John Drake flies to the Caribbean to aid an American journalist who had been arrested on a spy charge, but before he can effect a rescue is accused of the murder of a young nightclub singer.

John Drake is flying back to the mainland with two prisoners, when his plane crashes in the sea, near a tiny island. On reaching the island Drake finds himself a wanted man as the island's hermit owner believes Drake is an escaped prisoner.

Hardy assigns Drake to fly to the Middle East to find Vanessa Stewart, a beautiful girl wanted for espionage. Posing as a Baltic agent, Drake persuades her to accompany him before the British find her. A subplot comments drily on the ethics of espionage.

Drake is assigned to investigate the murder of a young G.I. in Munich. He was last seen in the company of a young German girl, Vicki. Was she involved in the plot? Drake, posing as an American soldier, must find the answer.
When several prominent people are killed, there appears to be no connection. But John Drake's investigations uncover a murder ring, which he hires to kill himself.

While vacationing on the Riviera, John Drake recognises a professional assassin. He succeeds in replacing the killer and undertakes an assignment working in the dark, as he has no idea who his victim is.
John Drake's assignment takes him to a small island off the coast of Brittany. He must protect Lady Lindsay, widow of a British diplomat, and her two young sons, from two killers.
When a Chinese businessman is murdered, a young couple on honeymoon become the prime suspects. John Drake flies out to the Far East to assist them, and finds himself in a dangerous situation.
John Drake travels to the Scottish Highlands when the fingerprints of a stolen car belong to a master spy believed to have been killed ten years earlier.
Drake's latest case is to unravel a security leak. The suspect is Ruth Mitchell, an interpreter; but as Drake later discovers, the girl has been used without her knowledge.

A plane crashes off the coast of Sicily and a diplomatic satchel is taken by mountain bandits. John Drake's task is to recover the stolen property, for which he enlists the aid of one bandit's girlfriend.
Drake travels to China to investigate the disappearance of an eminent doctor who had been trying to escape the Communist regime.

NATO agent Tony Costello is killed in a car crash while investigating a case of gun running. John Drake flies to Sicily to investigate and finds Costello's girl friend who is convinced it was murder. Before the case is solved, Drake discovers that you can bury the dead more than once.

When Paul Jason of Jason's Airlines is killed and several of his planes crash, John Drake assumes the identity of a hard drinking pilot to investigate the crash. Drake discovers a case of smuggling and finds himself in a tricky situation.

When several workers at an atomic energy plant in North Africa fall ill, a leakage is suspected. Drake flies out to investigate and is aided by a beautiful European doctor, but when the next victim has no connection with the plant, Drake discovers a fiendish plot.
Drake joins forces with a European doctor when workers at an African nuclear power plant fall ill.

Drake travels to Venice to investigate the case of Beth Warren, a cipher expert at the American Embassy in London. She disappeared form her job, and rushed to Venice to be with her boyfriend when his brother way dying. But Drake discovers she is being used for the knowledge she has.

Drake travels to Hong Kong to investigate the murder of a sound technician working for a radio station. He uncovers a plot where the secret information is being sent out in code over the air, transmitted as part of the station's English lessons.
Drake poses as a professional assassin in an attempt to prevent the assassination of a South American President. He joins a revolutionary group who are planning to kill the President.
John Drake travels to a Balkan country to investigate the misappropriation of funds by a Minister. Drake uncovers the plot. Involving love, politics and revenge.

A miniature submarine is wrecked off the coast of a South American country. John Drake's assignment from British Intelligence is to blow her up. Disguised as a fisherman, Drake races against time to find the submarine before the agents of a foreign power can.

When twenty five million dollars in forged currency floods the European capitals, John Drake is assigned by U.S. Intelligence to trace the source. The trail leads to an ex-Nazi General staying at a lake-side hotel in the mountains. Drake faces death before he can solve the case and uncover the secret of the lake.

Drake travels to the Arabian Desert to rescue the American Consul and his family from terrorists who have assassinated the King. On arrival Drake finds he has additional problems trying to protect a pretty Scots nurse and the baby in her care - the future king.

Hardy assigns Drake to investigate when the entire research team working in tropical diseases is killed by mysterious accidents. Drake travels to India, and uncovers clues that one of the scientists may be alive.

When a wave of terrorism in the African jungle is likely to lead to a mass uprising, The Danger Man takes on the disguise of a 'gun-runner' in an attempt to penetrate the extremist organisation behind it.

Mr. Brett is known to be giving away British industrial secrets. However, when Drake confronts him, he discovers things are a lot more complicated and that John Brett is not the only person being investigated.

An important M9 agent has gone missing in Prague, and Drake's sent in as a British diplomat to find him. It appears a blackmail ring is operating, and soon, Drake has to rescue the agent, and his family, from death.

Drake takes the place of a defector and goes behind the iron curtain to find out what is happening when foreign agents reach England. When he gets there he finds a replica English village, which is a school where foreign agents are taught to 'be British'. Actual British subjects, such as Drake, are employed to teach the agents the finer points of the British way of life.

Drake is sent to Africa to protect the prime minister, who is in the midst of an election campaign. It is suspected that the opposition leader is planning to overthrow the government but Drake finds out that it is much more complicated.

In a poignant reminder that spies are merely people and that they often take terrible punishment when caught, Drake tries to stop a former agent from killing the East German government official who had her tortured beyond repair.

M9 receives a mayday signal from an agent in an Arab country. He has been compromised and must get out. The agent is also the contact for a local spy called the Fish. Drake is sent undercover to bring the Fish out.

Drake is in India when he is asked by an old friend, the Delhi police chief, to investigate the mysterious death of the employee of a retired colonel. The colonel sells exotic butterflies but Drake finds out that there is a lot more to it.

A woman disguised as a clumsy tea lady steals some secret papers, which are sold to the highest bidder by a Mr Kent. M9 sends Drake to investigate a number of similar thefts by befriending the woman and infiltrating the organisation.

An international financier has come to the notice of M9, as he is believed to be an extortionist and murderer. When some important people are found dead, Drake goes undercover as a butler at the financier's rented villa in Rome.
Two M9 agents have been tortured and murdered on a Caribbean island, and Drake's sent to find out who killed them and to determine how much information they divulged before dying.
An agent is selling secrets to a foreign government. How he is doing this is unclear so Drake is brought in to find out, which he does by befriending him as a bumbling teacher on stress leave.
A glamorous actress is murdered and an M9 agent, whose cover has been discovered, is framed for her murder. Drake task is to get him out of jail and off the island using a submarine code-named Doris.
Confidential papers go missing, and Drake travels to a small island off the coast of Scotland in search of them and the culprit.

A prisoner is soon to be released and is offered a well-paid job that is obviously crooked. As he wants to go straight, he reports the approach. Drake takes his place in order to find out what the crime is to be, which is murder.

Drake discovers that a woman is financing political agitators in Santo Marco trying to bring down the government. He sets out to find out who employs her and why. Drake finds it is being funded by a rich member of the aristocracy.

To save a friend with sensitive information who is being held in the Romanian embassy in Geneva, Drake must break into the embassy, in defiance of the British ambassador, retrieve his friend, and avoid an international incident.

A former republican leader returns to his home country to retire. However, he is arrested by the current president and faces the death sentence, something both the British and Americans do not want to happen. Drake is sent in to stop it.

After a driving accident, Drake finds he has a £500 gambling debt at a club he has no knowledge of, yet the staff seem to know him, and the club's manager, Mr. Alexander knows all about Drake's career with M9, and plans to blackmail him.
A government officer's defected, and M9 wants him back, and Drake's to try and get him.

Drake follows a young lady, who has been selling secrets, to France where he confronts her with what he knows. Kathleen is being blackmailed and her role is to take the information to France. She offers to help Drake find who employs her.
Bierce is a British diplomat in France. He shoots a man, to whom he owes money, and hides the body. He then suddenly disappears. Drake is sent to try and find out what has happened to him.
A British husband and wife, both atomic scientists, disappear whilst on holiday. The suspicion is they've been kidnapped and Drake is sent to investigate.

eps.t: You Are Not in Any Trouble, Are You?
eps.d: After a fellow M9 agent is murdered Drake is sent to Rome to investigate and after retrieving the dead agent's tape recorder, learns about a ‘murder incorporated' organisation. Drake arranges for himself to be assassinated at midnight in order to flush out the assassin and to identify the leader of the organisation.
Drake goes undercover to discover who is blackmailing a general's brother.
A Chinese spy ring is operating in Singapore and Drake is sent to infiltrate, taking the place of a man already working for the ring, in order to try and bring the ring to an end.
Drake tries to get at an assassin by tailing the killer's mistress.

There's a nice Portuguese villa where an English lady and her husband reside. Lodger's there are suspected when the husband disappears and Drake is assigned to see what's going on. He is brought in on a smuggling ring by the lodgers who say they are smuggling industrial diamonds. In reality, they are smuggling missile electronics.

The Ministry wants to continue good relations with an African country. But agents have discovered that certain elements of that country have signed agreements with the Chinese. It is up to Drake to find the evidence of this and turn it over to the African country's Prime Minister in order to expose the truth to him and keep relations with the British.

An agent is killed in the field and Drake is sent to the African country where it happened to investigate the generals and leaders of a small mercenary band intent on seeing the country's leader die while under the knife in a hospital so that they may take control of the country.

Drake's immediate plans are disrupted when London authorizes him to pick up a doctor who is targeted by the opposition and bring him to London. He begins to suspect that forces are already moving against him before he gets very far.
There's a security leak and the suspect is murdered by someone unknown. Drake is assigned to unravel who killed the informant and discover just how the information was being passed on.

eps.t: Are You Going to Be More Permanent?
eps.d: Agents are disappearing. Drake is assigned to be the next courier in order to find out how. But he has three contacts along the way. All three have impeccable records. But which one is working for the other side?

Drake is asked to check up on an old friend who may be passing information to the opposition. He initially refuses the assignment, but decides to take the assignment figuring if there is any wrongdoing, he might be able to mitigate it.
Drake is working for Sir Alan Grose to try and find out who is the double agent within the organization.

Agent goes missing and M9 isn't sure if he is dead or alive. Drake is assigned to find out. What he finds is that it's a lot more complicated than anyone thinks as the opposition has found a way to infiltrate our side through the use of plastic surgery.
An agent has been captured and interrogated. Drake is assigned to spring him before he breaks.

eps.t: Someone is Liable to Get Hurt
eps.d: Drake is sent to get inside the political aspirations of a revolutionary candidate by posing as a gun runner.
A scientist accidentally develops a deadly gas that governments want their hands on. He flees the country and Drake is sent to bring him back before enemy agents grab him.

eps.t: I Can Only Offer You Sherry
eps.d: Classified information on British oil reserves is being leaked to foreign agents. Drake is sent to find out how.

Investigating several seemingly random leaks, Drake finds they've one thing in common; the wealthy Jordan's - Claudia and Basil. Drake becomes manservant to the very disparate couple, at their chateau in the Loire Valley of France, in order to find our what's so fascinating about the pair..
Drake is framed for the murder of a Latin American country leader and must clear his name and expose the real plot and assassins.

eps.t: I am Afraid You Have the Wrong Number
eps.d: An agent is kidnapped by one of the opposition and a body left in a burning car to make everyone think he was killed in a car crash. Drake determines he is not dead after all and sets out to find who kidnapped him and rescue him before it's too late.
While on a well deserved vacation, Drake is still in search of an enemy agent who knows his cover as a spy. If he can't apprehend him, his cover is blown.
Secret papers are stolen out of a government car by a local thief and have found their way to enemy agents. Drake leads a merry chase to find them before the weekend is over.
An obsolete offshore defense outpost is now being used as a radio station. It is also being used to send government secrets to enemy submarines.

A Japanese agent warns that a UN negotiator will be assassinated in New York by a Tokyo-based organisation. She is killed before she can give the details and Drake is sent to Tokyo to investigate. The only clue is a pendant the girl had.
An electronics expert working for the government suddenly retires. M9 wants to know why, and Drake takes his place. His search leads to an island off Japan; Shinda Shima.
